catalog_item.category_required: New items in this catalog need a category.
catalog_item.cost_pair_mismatch: Cost and cost currency go together — set both or clear both.
catalog_item.has_applications_one: '{{name}}' is applied to {{countDisplay}} kit — build history is kept, so it can't be deleted. Withdraw the application first if it's wrongly recorded.
catalog_item.has_applications_other: '{{name}}' is applied to {{countDisplay}} kits — build history is kept, so it can't be deleted. Withdraw the applications first if they're wrongly recorded.
catalog_item.not_found: That catalog item no longer exists.
catalog_item.on_order_history_one: '{{name}}' appears on {{countDisplay}} order line — order history is kept, so it can't be deleted.
catalog_item.on_order_history_other: '{{name}}' appears on {{countDisplay}} order lines — order history is kept, so it can't be deleted.

import.archive_damaged: '{{entry}}' couldn't be unpacked — the archive may be damaged, encrypted, or compressed in a way plamotrack can't read. Export it again.
import.archive_invalid: That file isn't a zip archive.
import.archive_too_large: That archive unpacks past the {{limitMb}} MB import limit. Split it into separate files.
import.blocked_one: The preview found {{countDisplay}} problem that blocks this import.
import.blocked_other: The preview found {{countDisplay}} problems that block this import.
import.catalog_ref_unresolved: $t(importField.catalog_ref_id): a {{itemType}} line has to point at a row in {{table}}.csv — give it a $t(importField.catalog_ref_id), or name the item in $t(importField.catalog_name) and one will be created at 0 on hand.
import.category_folded: Category '{{stated}}' will be stored as '{{stored}}', matching the spelling already in use.
import.column_unknown: Column '{{column}}' isn't a {{table}} column and was ignored.
import.confirm_required: Replacing everything wipes the current collection first — type REPLACE to confirm.
import.currency_unknown: {{field}}: '{{currency}}' isn't a currency code we recognise — it will be stored as typed, and its amounts read as having 2 decimal places.
import.currency_without_amount: {{field}}: ignored — this file has no {{amountField}} column, and a currency can't be changed without restating the amount it applies to.
import.encoding_invalid: {{source}} isn't valid UTF-8 (line {{line}}). Re-save it as UTF-8 — in Excel, 'CSV UTF-8' — and import it again.
import.file_too_large: That file is over the {{limitMb}} MB import limit. Split it into separate files.
import.format_foreign: This archive says it's '{{format}}', not a plamotrack export.
import.id_duplicated: Row {{row}} already uses this id — two rows in one upload can't carry the same id.
import.kept_stored: {{field}}: left as it was — this column can't be emptied, and nothing in this row supplies a new value.
import.kit_move_quantity_unstated: $t(importField.order_item_id): this would leave order line {{lineId}} holding {{after}} kit(s), and nothing in this upload says how many that line bought — state the quantity on its $t(importTable.order_items).csv row, or leave $t(importField.order_item_id) as it is.
import.kit_move_to_catalog_line: $t(importField.order_item_id): order line {{lineId}} is a {{itemType}} line, and a catalog line buys stock, not kits — point these kits at a kit line, or leave the column blank.
import.kit_move_unreconciled: $t(importField.order_item_id): this would leave order line {{lineId}} holding {{after}} kit(s) while the line says it bought {{quantity}} — set that line's quantity to what it should hold, or leave $t(importField.order_item_id) as it is.
import.kit_name_exists_one: You already have {{countDisplay}} kit called '{{name}}' — importing adds another, since two of the same kit are two kits.
import.kit_name_exists_other: You already have {{countDisplay}} kits called '{{name}}' — importing adds another, since two of the same kit are two kits.
import.kits_not_removable: This line's quantity asks for {{surplus}} kit(s) to be removed, but only {{removable}} can go safely — the rest have progressed or are described by this upload. Move or edit those kits first, or leave the quantity as it was.
import.kits_oversupplied: This line says quantity {{stated}}, but this upload supplies {{supplied}} kit(s) for it in kits.csv — take out the extra kit rows, or raise the quantity to match them.
import.kits_receive_advance_one: Marking this order received moves {{countDisplay}} kit to backlog.
import.kits_receive_advance_other: Marking this order received moves {{countDisplay}} kits to backlog.
import.kits_removal_planned_one: Will remove {{countDisplay}} kit from this line.
import.kits_removal_planned_other: Will remove {{countDisplay}} kits from this line.
import.kits_ship_advance_one: Marking this order shipped moves {{countDisplay}} kit to in transit.
import.kits_ship_advance_other: Marking this order shipped moves {{countDisplay}} kits to in transit.
import.kits_spawn_planned_one: Will create {{countDisplay}} kit from this line.
import.kits_spawn_planned_other: Will create {{countDisplay}} kits from this line.
import.line_joins_received: $t(importField.order_id): this {{itemType}} line would join an order that's already received, and an import never changes what you have on hand — add the line in the app instead, which applies the stock as it saves.
import.manifest_ambiguous_one: The archive holds {{countDisplay}} manifest file — there's no telling which one describes it, so nothing will be imported from it.
import.manifest_ambiguous_other: The archive holds {{countDisplay}} manifest files — there's no telling which one describes it, so nothing will be imported from it.
import.manifest_file_absent: The manifest lists {{filename}}, but it isn't in this archive — the zip is truncated or was only partly extracted.
import.manifest_file_ambiguous_one: The archive holds {{countDisplay}} file named {{filename}} — which one the manifest describes can't be told, so the row counts can't be trusted.
import.manifest_file_ambiguous_other: The archive holds {{countDisplay}} files named {{filename}} — which one the manifest describes can't be told, so the row counts can't be trusted.
import.manifest_metadata_unreadable: manifest.json has metadata this instance can't read — continuing without it.
import.manifest_missing: No manifest.json in this zip, so it's being read as a loose set of CSVs.
import.manifest_not_object: manifest.json isn't an object, so it says nothing about this archive — continuing without it.
import.manifest_rows_mismatch: {{filename}}: the manifest says {{declared}} row(s) but {{read}} could be read — this archive isn't intact.
import.manifest_table_mismatch: The manifest files {{filename}} under '{{declared}}', but its columns are {{routed}} — importing it as {{routed}}.
import.manifest_unreadable: manifest.json couldn't be read — continuing without it.
import.match_ambiguous_one: {{countDisplay}} existing {{table}} row matches this one — set the id column to say which one you mean.
import.match_ambiguous_other: {{countDisplay}} existing {{table}} rows match this one — set the id column to say which one you mean.
import.member_duplicated: The archive holds more than one member called '{{path}}', so it can't be read reliably and nothing will be imported from it.
import.member_undeclared: '{{path}}' isn't listed in the archive's manifest, but {{rows}} row(s) were read from it — the manifest doesn't describe everything in this zip.
import.member_unrecognised: '{{path}}' isn't recognised as any known table — skipped.
import.money_ambiguous: {{field}}: a comma here is ambiguous in this currency — write the amount with a decimal point, or with no separator at all.
import.natural_key_duplicated: Row {{row}} already describes this {{field}} — give one of them an id if they're meant to be different.
import.no_table_data: That archive contained no readable table data.
import.order_match_ambiguous_one: {{countDisplay}} existing order matches this one ({{matchedBy}}) — set the id column to say which one you mean.
import.order_match_ambiguous_other: {{countDisplay}} existing orders match this one ({{matchedBy}}) — set the id column to say which one you mean.
import.plan_stale: The collection changed since this preview, so it no longer matches what would happen — run the preview again.
import.preview_required: Preview the import first — an apply is only allowed to do what a preview showed.
import.provenance_protected: $t(importField.order_item_id): this kit is building or complete, rated, photographed, or has upgrades applied, so the order line that bought it can't be taken away — leave $t(importField.order_item_id) as it is.
import.receipt_conflict: Row {{row}}: received contradicts row {{otherRow}} of the same order — an order either arrived or it didn't, so every row of one order has to agree.
import.receipt_unaccounted: $t(importField.received_at): marking this order received would leave the stock its catalog lines bought unaccounted for — take $t(importField.received_at) out of this sheet and receive the order in the app, which applies the stock.
import.ref_dangling: {{field}}: no {{table}} here has id {{id}}, so this row imports without it. Add that {{table}} row, or fill it in afterwards.
import.ref_ignored_kit_line: {{field}}: a kit line doesn't reference the catalog — its kits are spawned fresh, so the value was ignored.
import.ref_not_in_upload: {{field}}: no {{table}} row with id {{id}} in this upload — a replace-all import deletes everything the upload doesn't contain, so add that row or name it by its readable column.
import.ref_overwrite_unresolved: {{field}}: id {{id}} names nothing here, and this row currently points at a stored {{table}} — an id that names nothing can't be what clears that link. Fix the id, or leave the column out of this sheet.
import.ref_unmatched: {{field}}: no matching {{table}} found — add it to the import or fix the reference.
import.rows_unreadable_one: {{countDisplay}} row couldn't be read — nothing will be imported until it's fixed or removed.
import.rows_unreadable_other: {{countDisplay}} rows couldn't be read — nothing will be imported until they're fixed or removed.
import.schema_drift: The archive was exported from schema {{archiveSchema}} and this instance is on {{instanceSchema}} — importing anyway, but check the result.
import.singleton_missing: This instance holds no {{table}} row to update — run migrations before importing.
import.spawn_source_missing_one: This kit line needs {{countDisplay}} more kit, but has no $t(importField.kit_name)/$t(importField.kit_grade) to create it from — fill those in, or supply the kits in $t(importTable.kits).csv.
import.spawn_source_missing_other: This kit line needs {{countDisplay}} more kits, but has no $t(importField.kit_name)/$t(importField.kit_grade) to create them from — fill those in, or supply the kits in $t(importTable.kits).csv.
import.status_stamp_generated: $t(importField.status_updated_at) will be set to the time of this import — this row moves the status without saying when it moved.
import.stock_note: Stock levels come from the catalog files. Importing orders never changes what you have on hand.
import.stub_created: Created from a reference on {{table}} row {{row}}.
import.stub_created_unstocked: Created from a reference on {{table}} row {{row}}, at 0 on hand.
import.table_unknown: Couldn't tell which table '{{filename}}' holds. Name the file after its table, or use the starter sheet template.
import.target_duplicated: Row {{row}} already claims this record — two rows in one upload can't describe the same one.
import.too_many_rows: That import is over the {{maximum}}-row limit. Split it up.
import.unreceive_unaccounted: $t(importField.received_at): clearing it would leave already-applied stock where it is while making the order receivable again — if the receipt was a mistake, delete the order and enter it again as pending.
import.value_required_for_create: {{field}}: a new {{table}} row needs this, and this one has no value for it. Fill the column in.
import.version_newer: This archive was written by a newer version of plamotrack (format {{exportVersion}}; this instance reads {{supportedVersion}}). Update before importing it.

kit.has_applications_one: '{{name}}' has {{countDisplay}} upgrade applied — that record explains the stock it used, so the kit is kept. Withdraw the application first; withdrawal asks whether its stock returns.
kit.has_applications_other: '{{name}}' has {{countDisplay}} upgrades applied — those records explain the stock they used, so the kit is kept. Withdraw the applications first; each withdrawal asks whether its stock returns.
kit.order_spawned: '{{name}}' came from an order line — edit that order (reduce the line quantity or remove the line) instead, so the purchase record and the collection stay consistent.

name.duplicate: Something named '{{name}}' already exists — names match case-insensitively, so reuse it or pick a different name.

order.already_received: This order is already marked received.
order.already_shipped: This order is already marked shipped.
order.fanout_limit: That would create {{total}} kits at once — the limit is {{maximum}}. Split it up.
order.lines_omitted_one: {{countDisplay}} stored line is missing from this edit — an omitted line is deleted. Restate every line you're keeping, or allow removal explicitly.
order.lines_omitted_other: {{countDisplay}} stored lines are missing from this edit — omitted lines are deleted. Restate every line you're keeping, or allow removal explicitly.
order.not_received: This order isn't received yet — record the arrival first; an edit only corrects a date already set.
order.not_shipped: This order isn't marked shipped yet — record the shipment first; an edit only corrects a date already set.
order.receipt_in_future: That arrival date is in the future — an arrival can be backdated, not predicted.
order.shipment_in_future: That ship date is in the future — a shipment can be backdated, not predicted.
order.unreceive_unsupported: An order can't be un-received — delete and re-enter it instead.

order_line.catalog_ref_dangling: This line points at a catalog item that no longer exists, so its stock can't be adjusted. Deleting the order undoes the entry wholesale.
order_line.duplicated: One of the order's lines appears twice.
order_line.item_type_immutable: A line's item type can't change — remove the line and add a new one.
order_line.kits_protected: Only {{deletable}} of the {{requested}} kits on this line can be removed safely — the rest are building, complete, rated, photographed, or have upgrades applied. Move or edit those kits first.
order_line.no_kit_to_clone: This line has no kits to copy details from — restate the kit details to add more.
order_line.not_on_order: One of the lines doesn't belong to this order.
order_line.order_immutable: A line can't change orders — that's the purchase record. Leave order_id as it is, and add a new line to the other order if that's what you meant.
order_line.quantity_too_large: Quantity is {{quantity}} — a line holds at most {{maximum}}. Split it across several lines.
order_line.quantity_too_small: Quantity is {{quantity}} — it has to be at least 1. To record nothing, leave the line out.

request.body_invalid: The request couldn't be read — if this was a file upload, try it again.

retailer.has_orders_one: '{{name}}' has {{countDisplay}} order — order history is kept, so the retailer can't be deleted.
retailer.has_orders_other: '{{name}}' has {{countDisplay}} orders — order history is kept, so the retailer can't be deleted.

settings.field_required: {{field}} always has a value — leave it out to keep the current one.
settings.value_invalid: That's not a valid value for {{field}}.

stock.insufficient: Can't remove {{requested}} × '{{name}}' — only {{onHand}} on hand. Adjust its stock first.
stock.limit_exceeded: '{{name}}' can't hold that many — stock counts max out at 2,147,483,647.

upgrade_application.not_found: That upgrade application no longer exists.
upgrade_application.quantity_invalid: Quantity must be a positive whole number.

value.out_of_range: {{value}} is out of range — whole numbers here go from −2,147,483,648 to 2,147,483,647.

data.subtitle: Back up your collection, move it somewhere else, or bring it in from a spreadsheet.
data.exportDescription: Plain CSV — yours to keep, open anywhere, and import straight back.
data.templatesDescription: Starting points for entering a collection by hand.
data.starterBlurb: The starter sheet is one row per kit — name, grade, where you bought it — and the app works out the retailers, orders, and order lines from that. The template pack is one blank file per table, for when you want to control everything.
data.importDescription: Nothing is written until you've seen exactly what will change.
data.replaceConfirm: This deletes your current collection. Type REPLACE to confirm.

importPreview.recordsDeleted_other: {{countDisplay}} existing records will be deleted first.

orders.title: Orders
orders.orderGone: This order no longer exists — it was deleted from another window or by an agent.
orders.loadOrderFailed: Couldn't load this order: {{message}}. Close and reopen to retry.
orders.alreadyInHand: Already in hand (store purchase / delivery arrived) — stock counts immediately
orders.preOrderToggle: Pre-order — kits wait as Pre-ordered until this order ships or arrives
orders.inHandNotPreOrder: An order already in hand cannot be a pre-order
orders.shippedCorrectHelp: Correcting this re-dates kits still marked In Transit by that shipment; kits moved since keep their own dates.
orders.shippedSetHelp: Setting a date marks the order shipped — kits still waiting on the retailer move to In Transit. Leave blank if it hasn't.
orders.receivedCorrectHelp: Correcting this re-dates the kits this delivery brought in — unless they have been moved since, in which case they keep their own dates.
orders.receivedSetHelp: Setting a date marks the order received — stock is applied and pipeline kits move to Backlog. Leave blank if it hasn't arrived.
orders.editLinesHelp: A kit detail you change here is applied to every kit this line spawned; one you leave alone stays as it is on each of them, so kits edited individually keep their own. Removing a line undoes it (kits deleted, stock reversed) — kits that are building/complete, rated, or have photos are protected.
orders.snapshotNote: what this cost at entry — recorded once, never recalculated. Blank for none.
orders.preOrderTooltip: All kits on this order are pre-ordered — not due yet
orders.showLineItems: Show line items for the {{date}} order from {{retailer}}
orders.hideLineItems: Hide line items for the {{date}} order from {{retailer}}
orders.confirmDelete:
Delete the {{date}} order from {{retailer}}?

This undoes the entry: kits it spawned are deleted and any applied stock is reversed. Progressed kits or consumed stock will block it.
orders.empty: No orders yet — record one and it will spawn your kits.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Instance-wide configuration — every browser and agent that connects here sees the same values.

general.currencyDescription: The default currency for new orders, and the currency converted price snapshots are recorded in.
general.currencyNote: Changing this affects new entries only. Amounts already recorded keep the currency they were entered with — nothing historical is rewritten or reinterpreted.

language.description: Interface language and regional formatting are stored on the instance, not in the browser — every client renders from the same values.
language.currentDescription: Saved instance-wide. Dates, times and numbers everywhere re-render with what you choose here.
language.fallbackWarning: This instance is set to '{{tag}}', which this build doesn't ship — showing English (Australia) until a shipped language is saved.
language.timeZoneHint: IANA zone name, e.g. Australia/Sydney — used wherever a stored moment renders as local time.
